privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: What we collect, why, and what you can do about it.
privacy.s1b: When you create an account we store your name, email address, matriculation number, and — if you choose to provide them — your study programme, degree level, year of study, the year you arrived in Chemnitz, where you are from, a phone number and a short bio. Your password is never stored: we keep only a one-way cryptographic hash of it.
privacy.s2b: Your name and email identify your account and let us contact you about the community. The matriculation number confirms you are a student and prevents duplicate accounts. The optional details help us welcome new arrivals and organise events that suit our members.
privacy.s3b: Your details are visible to you and to the BSUC committee. We do not sell your data, and we do not share it with third parties for advertising. A phone number, if you give one, is only visible to the committee.
privacy.s4b: We keep your data for as long as your account exists. If you delete your account, it is removed from our database immediately, along with everything linked to it.
privacy.s5b: You can view and correct your details at any time on your profile page, and you can delete your account yourself from the same page. Under the GDPR you also have the right to request a copy of your data, to object to its processing, and to complain to a supervisory authority.
privacy.s6b: For any question about your data, write to us using the address on our contact page.
